note: The one resource address stack 30 plans with state_bucket_enabled true and the defaults (region tor1, resource_key empty). With the flag false (the default) the stack plans nothing, so a plan of the live, unapplied stack has no resources at all. scripts/plan_noop_check.py applies this list only to a stack that has been applied; nothing has been. tests/test_golden_state_bucket.py ties this file to the sources. A pull request that adds a resource updates this file on purpose.
